newsitem.title: USA: Shell Wood River, Illinois refinery hit by fire.
newsitem.headline: Shell Wood River, Illinois refinery hit by fire.

text.p: Shell Oil has experienced a fire at its 268,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery in Wood River, Illinois, according to police and fire department spokesmen.
There no details immediately available on the extent of the fire. The police spokesman said Shell was handling the fire "internally," but did not elaborate on what had occurred.
"They called and said 'there is a fire, but we are going to handle it ourselves,'" said Captain Dana Emerick of the Wood RiverFire Department.
